pumac-2010-algebra-a-01.prompt: Find the sum of the coefficients of the polynomial $(63x-61)^4$.

pumac-2010-algebra-a-02.prompt: Calculate $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(\left\lfloor\sqrt[n]{2010}\right\rfloor-1\right)$, where $\lfloor x\rfloor$ is the largest integer less than or equal to $x$.

pumac-2010-algebra-a-05.prompt: Let $f(x)=3x^3-5x^2+2x-6$. If the roots of $f$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$, find $$\left(\frac1{\alpha-2}\right)^2+\left(\frac1{\beta-2}\right)^2+\left(\frac1{\gamma-2}\right)^2.$$

pumac-2010-algebra-a-08.prompt: Let $p$ be a polynomial with integer coefficients such that $p(15)=6$, $p(22)=1196$, and $p(35)=26$. Find an integer $n$ such that $p(n)=n+82$.
